_comment: wave 26 (gap-closing batch 2): completes the date arithmetic family + span-array accessors + the first static-object-literal operator. add_date_int/minus_date_int return a DateADT VALUE serialized via the new date_out value-return kind (VALUE_OUT_RETURNS in codegen_nebula.py). set_spans/spanset_spans (contiguous Span array, span_val) and spanset_spanarr (Span* pointer array, ptr) use the existing array_out machinery over an int set/spanset primary (intspan_out serializer; the function is subtype-agnostic, int chosen to prove it). dwithin_cbuffer_cbuffer is the first operator over the new cbuffer object-literal primary (cbuffer_in) with a second Cbuffer via a box-kind extra and a scalar distance. All symbols probed present in v15 libmeos (CBUFFER/POSE/NPOINT gates on); the gap was a missing generator input-shape, not a compile gate.

operators.comment_one_liner: add_date_int (DateADT) - the date shifted forward by a number of days.
minus_date_int (DateADT) - the date shifted back by a number of days.
set_spans (Span *) - the array of singleton spans of a set.
spanset_spans (Span *) - the array of spans of a span set.
spanset_spanarr (Span **) - the array of span pointers of a span set.
dwithin_cbuffer_cbuffer (int) - whether two circular buffers are within a distance.
